queries.query: select case when total_mesas is null then 0 else total_mesas end as total_mesas from( select sum(m.valor_total) as total_mesas from mesa m where m.fecha_orden between :fechaInicial and :fechaFinal and m.estado_orden='A' )sub

SELECT CASE WHEN sub2.valor_total is null THEN 0 ELSE sub2.valor_total END AS valor_total, CASE WHEN sub2.valor_porcentaje is null THEN 0 ELSE sub2.valor_porcentaje END AS valor_porcentaje FROM ( SELECT sub1.valor_total,sub1.valor_porcentaje FROM ( SELECT SUM(sub0.valor_total) as valor_total, SUM(sub0.valor_porcentaje) as valor_porcentaje FROM( SELECT m.id_dian,m.valor_total,CASE WHEN m.id_dian = 0 or m.id_dian is null THEN 0 ELSE m.valor_total END valor_porcentaje FROM mesa m WHERE m.fecha_orden BETWEEN :fechaInicial and :fechaFinal and m.estado_orden='A' )sub0 )sub1 )sub2
